atoms.text: Rahul, Arjun and Naveen are three best friends living in a city in the north-east of India. In the mornings, they go to the river together to swim and do their chores.
atoms.sound: ssml: Rahul, Arjun and Naveen are three best friends living in a city in the north-east of India.<break time='400ms'/> In the mornings, they go to the river together to swim and do their chores.

atoms.text: First, they help with the washing at the river. But, they quickly realise that they don’t have a basket for their laundry. The river is too far away from home to go back, what will they do?
atoms.sound: ssml: First, they help with the washing at the river.<break time='400ms'/> But, they quickly realise that they don’t have a basket for their laundry.<break time='400ms'/> The river is too far away from home to go back, what will they do?

atoms.text: Rahul, Arjun and Naveen are feeling frustrated. So, they decide to go for a swim to lighten the mood. After swimming for an hour, Arjun realises that they don’t have towels!
atoms.sound: ssml: Rahul, Arjun and Naveen are feeling frustrated.<break time='400ms'/> So, they decide to go for a swim to lighten the mood.<break time='400ms'/> After swimming for an hour, Arjun realises that they don’t have towels!

atoms.text: Naveen reassures Rahul and Arjun that they will dry in the sun, as the weather is scorching - problem solved! But, they still have to walk back to the town with the wet laundry in their hands!
atoms.sound: ssml: Naveen reassures Rahul and Arjun that they will dry in the sun, as the weather is scorching - problem solved!<break time='400ms'/> But, they still have to walk back to the town with the wet laundry in their hands!

atoms.text: After they are back in town, Rahul, Arjun and Naveen decide to play football. They play in a busy park and make up their own goals and lines. Usually, they can find lots of other kids to play with them too, but nobody was out today!
atoms.sound: ssml: After they are back in town, Rahul, Arjun and Naveen decide to play football.<break time='400ms'/> They play in a busy park and make up their own goals and lines.<break time='400ms'/> Usually, they can find lots of other kids to play with them too, but nobody was out today!

atoms.text: Then, they have to go home, and it is time for dinner.
atoms.sound: Then, they have to go home, and it is time for dinner.

b: ++leaving it by the door, so you won’t forget it next time

atoms.a: What’s the best solution for having nobody to play with?
b: ++asking friends to meet at a set time in advance
